description: Ask an athlete on the roster to pay for one of the coach's offers, as the Get paid dialog's Ask to pay does: the athlete sees a Pay card on their plan and, unless send_email is false, gets an email from the coach with the link (replies go to the coach). They pay into the coach's own Stripe account; card details are only typed in the app. An open ask for the same offer is returned rather than doubled, and asking again re-sends the email. Needs the Stripe account ready (get_payment_setup). Ask the coach before sending.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

note.description: An optional line from the coach, at the top of the email

name: request_payment
